[EN] It Lives
[ES] Está vivo
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Look at the water. It's full of information.
[ES] Mira el agua. Está llena de información.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The whole swamp may be alive. Imagine that.
[ES] Todo el pantano podría estar vivo. Imagínate eso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Zalgeg Coil
[ES] Bobina de Zalgeg
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy a {@creature:45#7001$$zalgeg coil} near {@Rgn:45011$$Swampwatch Camp}, and collect a fragment.
[ES] Destruye un {@creature:45#7001$$zalgeg coil} cerca de {@Rgn:45011$$Swampwatch Camp} y recoge un fragmento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the fragment back to Setahl.
[ES] Lleva el fragmento de vuelta a Setahl.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Happy to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
